question: Which government has become the world's first government to turn 100% paperless?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dubai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dubai has become the first government in the world to turn 100 per cent paperless.
 
• This was announced by Emirate's Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.
 
• The emirate has achieved the objectives of the ‘Dubai Paperless Strategy, which was launched in 2018.
 
• The strategy was implemented in five consecutive phases.
